title: Chinese Carbon Wireless Gravel Bike - Full Workshop Build - ICAN TriAero Graro & Wheeltop GeX

takeaways.text: In April 2025 the frameset with fork, seatpost, headset and fittings was quoted at £717, plus about £300 for custom paint; the frame, groupset and wheels were supplied free by the makers.
Built with 44 mm WTB Raddler tires on ICAN G25 wheels; the video does not test the frame's maximum clearance.
The brake mounts were not faced at the factory; the builder left them as most home builders would. Integrated bar routing meant the pre-cut hydraulic hoses had to be shortened and re-terminated.
After assembly a little hose pull was heard when turning the bars, judged minimal. The T47 bottom bracket edge can chew the repainted shell, so the builder filed back the paint first.
All parts came to £2,214, or about £2,354 including UK shipping, before the creator's discount codes.
The finished bike with Wheeltop EDS GeX 1× wireless, GRX crank, ICAN carbon wheels and 44 mm tires weighed 8.6 kg without pedals; frame size was not stated (the rider is nearly 6 ft).

disclosure: The description discloses affiliate commissions and an ICAN discount code; frame-supply terms are not established by the description.
summary: Workshop assembly of a custom Graro with Wheeltop GeX shifting. The parts and budget belong to this build, not the catalog build estimate.
